title: Cancel-flow fairness: who gets offers, and does no mean no
about: 16 members (both plans, short and long tenure, four reasons each) cancel; every offer is declined. Offers by group: Signature bag, under 2 months: 2 of 4 offered, 0 discounts; Signature bag, over 6 months: 2 of 4 offered, 1 discounts; Half bag, under 2 months: 2 of 4 offered, 0 discounts; Half bag, over 6 months: 2 of 4 offered, 1 discounts. Shop figures: 8 offers made, 0 accepted, median 0 s from request to cancel.
